title: Table and Private Dining Entitlements of the Mountain Dining Plans
content:
Alongside the balance it carries, each of the Mountain Dining Plans carries a set of hospitality entitlements: the number of calendar days ahead within which the holder may reserve a table, priority seating at table service outlets where the plan includes it, the number of chef's table seatings the plan carries over the season, a wine locker at a collective outlet where the plan includes one, and the hours of private dining room use the plan carries over the season.

## Entitlements by plan

| Plan | Days ahead a table may be reserved | Priority seating | Chef's table seatings over the season | Wine locker | Private dining room hours over the season |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Mountain Bites Dining Card | 0 | not included | 0 | not included | 0 |
| Peak Plate Dining Plan | 7 | not included | 0 | not included | 0 |
| Summit Table Dining Plan | 14 | not included | 0 | not included | 0 |
| Alpine Club Dining Membership | 30 | included | 2 | not included | 0 |
| Chef's Table Dining Membership | 60 | included | 6 | included | 4 |
| Collective Hospitality Dining Membership | 120 | included | 12 | included | 16 |

## Where each entitlement first appears in the range

The reservation window is the only entitlement every plan above the Mountain Bites Dining Card carries, running from 7 days ahead on the Peak Plate Dining Plan to 120 days ahead on the Collective Hospitality Dining Membership. Priority seating and chef's table seatings first appear on the Alpine Club Dining Membership, which carries 2 seatings over the season. A wine locker and private dining room hours first appear on the Chef's Table Dining Membership, whose 4 hours over the season are quadrupled to 16 on the Collective Hospitality Dining Membership.

A worked reading on hypothetical dates: a household on the Summit Table Dining Plan, whose window runs 14 days ahead, looking at a table on the fourteenth day from today is looking at the last date the window reaches; the same household on the Alpine Club Dining Membership, whose window runs 30 days ahead, would reach more than twice as far.
